## Fixed

- **Streaming answers now keep following your scroll to the last line.** A tall markdown block (list, code block) landing in one re-render pass could break the auto-follow permanently — stickiness is now sampled *before* each re-render instead of after, so following survives any content jump (scrolling up to re-read is still respected).
- **Sources card and copy/save buttons are scrolled into view when a turn finishes.** The final swap (thinking panel + answer + sources + actions) previously landed below the fold with no closing scroll; the view now settles at the bottom when you were following along.
